title: Either Way: Disjunctive Concessions (akár... akár...)
grammar: Disjunctive conditional concessions: akár eljön, akár nem; akárhogy is nézzük
goal: I can construct exhaustive binary concessions using akár... akár... ('whether... or...').
I can use discourse markers like akárhogy is nézzük ('however we look at it').
I can show that two opposite premises lead to the exact same logical outcome.
